verdict.rationale: Vercel's CLI is documented for use "through an automated system" as well as a terminal. Access tokens authenticate both the CLI and the REST API, and they can be scoped to a single project to keep "jobs, tools, and workflows" constrained. Headless automation is further supported by the REST API with a live OpenAPI spec, deployment webhooks, and git-push-triggered deploys. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions setup, non-interactive/token flags for the CLI), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
